# SiteCheck AI

SiteCheck AI is a web-based website analysis service for business owners. It analyzes measurable signals around SEO, technical quality, mobile experience, content, trust and conversion, then explains practical improvement opportunities.

## Scope

SiteCheck AI is an automated first analysis, not a guarantee of rankings or conversions and not a substitute for every specialist audit. It only claims to assess signals that were actually measured or retrieved during a scan.

## Languages

Dutch, English, German, French and Spanish landing pages are available. Blog content is currently available in Dutch and English.
